name: Відкритий напад (2)
description:
The discovered attack remains one of the most important chess tricks. So we will continue to practice. When two pieces of the same color are aligned, they form a battery. By moving the piece in front, the view of the back piece (bishop, rook or queen) opens up. You can suddenly attack two pieces at the same time.

What do you have to do?

Win material by performing a discovered attack.

examples.text: Kijk goed naar stukken die op dezelfde lijn staan. Met 1.Tf8+! kan wit zomaar de zwarte dame winnen.
By giving a check, white can win material with a discovered attack. The remaining endgame is very promising for white.
The d-file is filled with pieces. With 1...Bxf3+! Black creates a powerful discovered attack.

texts: The white bishop eyes over its pawn and spots a black queen!
